content:
An existing clash already requires the same task as this clash:
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/272fcfd47136ece474e35d3243056d60a63

Please use a different idea for your contribution.

Also, please keep the following in mind:

* Cases should be renumbered after they're reordered.

* Each test and its corresponding validator should cover the same scenario. In your contribution, some tests don't align with their validators. For example, Validator 4 corresponds more closely to Validator 7 than to Test 4.

Thanks.
